categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Rendu Biotechnology Co., Ltd. focuses on RNA molecular diagnostics, developing and commercializing RNA real-time fluorescence isothermal amplification (SAT) technology-based diagnostic reagents and integrated equipment. Its main product lines include molecular diagnostic reagents for reproductive tract infections, respiratory pathogens, blood-borne infectious diseases, tumor auxiliary diagnostics, and supporting automated detection instruments. The company also operates a third-party medical testing service through its subsidiary, providing clinical diagnostic services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technology is the proprietary RNA real-time fluorescence isothermal amplification (SAT) platform, enabling real-time detection of RNA targets with high specificity and sensitivity. It also utilizes multi-target RNA amplification, capture probe methods, and industrial-scale production of core enzymes. The AutoSAT system is a fully automated, high-throughput RNA nucleic acid detection platform integrating nucleic acid extraction, amplification, detection, and result analysis, supporting rapid and accurate diagnostics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include hospitals, third-party independent laboratories, disease control centers, and customs authorities across China. The products serve clinical diagnostics in reproductive health, respiratory diseases, blood infections, tumor screening, and infectious disease control. The company’s products are used in over 700 medical institutions nationwide, including top-tier hospitals such as Peking Union Medical College Hospital and Fudan University Huashan Hospital.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, covering all 31 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions. It has begun international market expansion with product approvals and collaborations in India and Thailand. Its registered office and main operations are based in Shanghai’s Zhangjiang Hi-Tech Park.
categories.supply_chain_position: Rendu Biotechnology operates across the midstream and downstream segments of the molecular diagnostics supply chain. It manufactures core raw materials (enzymes), develops diagnostic reagents and instruments, and provides third-party clinical testing services, forming an integrated full-industry chain from raw material production to end-user clinical application.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in RNA molecular diagnostics, focusing on unmet clinical needs in infectious diseases and tumor diagnostics. It invests heavily in R&D, with 25% of revenue allocated to research, developing new reagents and automated instruments. Ongoing projects include HIV, hepatitis B and C, HPV detection kits, and tumor early detection products. The company also strengthens intellectual property protection and aims to enhance automation and throughput in diagnostic platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through sales of molecular diagnostic reagents, diagnostic instruments, and third-party clinical testing services. The company employs a sales model dominated by distribution with supplementary direct sales to medical institutions and laboratories. It also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Rendu Biotechnology is a leading domestic player in RNA molecular diagnostics, especially in reproductive tract and respiratory pathogen detection. It holds a strong market position with the largest market share in RNA-based reproductive tract pathogen testing in China. The company competes with multinational corporations like Roche and Abbott in high-end markets but differentiates through proprietary SAT technology and integrated automated platforms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 164.4 million, a 45.9% decline from the previous year due to reduced COVID-19 related testing demand. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 8.26 million, down 64.6%. Despite revenue decline, R&D investment increased by 20.3% to RMB 41.1 million, representing 25% of revenue. The company maintains strong cash flow and total assets of about RMB 1.05 billion, with stable net assets near RMB 963 million.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Rendu Biotechnology’s unique value lies in its proprietary RNA real-time fluorescence isothermal amplification (SAT) technology, which offers higher specificity and sensitivity by targeting RNA of live pathogens, reducing false positives common in DNA-based tests. Its fully automated AutoSAT system enables rapid, high-throughput, and flexible testing suitable for clinical and point-of-care settings. The company’s integrated model from core enzyme production to reagents, instruments, and testing services ensures quality control, cost efficiency, and comprehensive solutions addressing unmet clinical diagnostic needs.
